Tuesday Calallen Ride

Corpus Christi, TX · West Guth Park · Road

Tuesday Calallen Ride is a road group ride in Corpus Christi, TX. It rolls every Tuesday at 6:10 pm from West Guth Park swimming pool.

For visitors

There is an option to loop back to the river at Callicoate for an extra 5 miles. A ride contact is named in the listing; ask the club for the current contact.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:10 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: no-drop; 16 or 21 mile options. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Tuesday Calallen Ride group ride

A Tuesday-evening no-drop ride out of West Guth Park along the I-37 access road to Labonte Park and back. Choose 16 or 21 miles.
